description: Ba₂NaReO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ReO₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.31 Å. Ba is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent ReO₆ octahedra. All Ba-O bond lengths are 2.98 Å. Re is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form ReO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Re-O bond lengths are 1.90 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na, four equivalent Ba, and one Re atom.
